ms.text:
Method to include:
(Hot) water in copper can, time taken for temperature to drop
Correct use of at least 3 larger outer containers, separately
Some indication that size of air gap is measured
Any two from:
Use of something to cover air gap
Use of lid on copper can
Same starting temperature
Same room temperature
Same volume of hot water
Use of ‘control’ with no outer container
Inner container standing on an insulator
Uniform air gap all round
Table with clear columns for temperature and/or time (to match method) and air-gap, with appropriate units
Conclusion: Least temperature drop OR longest time for temperature to drop shows lowest cooling rate OR best insulation
OR plot temperature against time and least gradient shows lowest cooling rate (ora)
